request.subject: UNIT:UNDEAD:PATROL_BOAT

layers.text: Turn it into a spooky ghost ship: the pale hull becomes near-black charcoal wood, colour #2a2a30, with a pale ivory bone rail and a big pale ivory skull figurehead on the bow; the red sail becomes tattered dark charcoal grey cloth, colour #5a5660, with torn zigzag edges; the pennant becomes a torn black rag; one small lantern glowing bright violet hangs from the mast. Keep the mast, boat shape, size, thick black outline and style exactly the same, with nothing under the hull.
